test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, PLUS is written as SOXV and LIVE is written as OLYH. How will FREE be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53fd1656625094d78e75277f510418b74aca0b3552a5fb2d37b1dcc5f3a0fb68.png] 

The logic followed here is:

PLUS is written as SOXV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9df115979d1d3b0855ef64e925037de5928f3ea24a187e76526532ba1e484aa.png] 

LIVE is written as OLYH.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d2765edd0f6c49fe114b5dbb6cb548c68c627fd9c28ca22ddbbe4dfb84c7c15.png] 

Similarly, **FREE **will be written;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b2bd2bd73aca117f75b33dfad91f5e35b36c3e69d1eb7f1fcf7b9ce14261d43.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "IUHH".**
